tweets.text: TeraWulf signed a 20-year, $19B lease with Anthropic to host AI compute in Kentucky. Bitcoin miners with cheap power are becoming the landlords of the AI boom — and steady lease income dwarfs volatile block rewards.

Japan's parliament slashed crypto taxes from 55% to 20% and reclassified digital assets as financial instruments. That's not incremental — it's a regime change opening the door to spot Bitcoin ETFs in the world's third-largest economy.

Strategy went quiet. Three of the last four weekly 8-Ks show zero BTC purchases — and the one that wasn't quiet revealed 3,588 BTC sold for $216M. After years of buy-only accumulation, the pattern is broken.

The US government moved $88M in seized Bitcoin to Coinbase Prime — the first real test of Trump's executive order saying reserve BTC shall not be sold. Everyone's watching whether "shall not" actually holds.
